name: fortiGuardThreatAnalyticsDemo
title: FortiGuard Threat Analytics (Enhanced)
subTitle: FortiGuard threat analytics with a country heat map and headline numbers
releaseNotes: Fork of FortiGuard Threat Analytics 1.0.0: headline numbers vs the 21-day daily average, a country heat map that filters the cards on click, self-drawn ranked cards (no utilities widget needed).

metadata.description: FortiGuard threat analytics for demos: headline event counts with trend, a world heat map of targeted countries, and ranked top threats, countries and industries for malware and vulnerability exploits.
